narrative.intro: Sprezzatura Management Consulting has $240M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Sprezzatura Management Consulting won 7 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $34.3M and obligations that are up 994.4% year over year. Sprezzatura Management Consulting shows a sharp jump in FY26 compared with prior years, where obligations ranged from $13.5M to $21.9M in FY24 and FY25 and were as low as $15.6M in FY22. Sprezzatura Management Consulting’s obligations concentrate in a few markets. Sprezzatura Management Consulting recorded $234M in Custom Computer Programming Services and smaller amounts in Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services and Computer Systems Design Services. Sprezzatura Management Consulting’s top buying agency is the Department of Veterans Affairs with $241M in obligations. This snapshot covers fiscal year to date totals and reflects current-year obligations rather than full-year totals.
